title: subscribe_events uses split_off+reassign; prefer drain
description: In client.rs subscribe_events, after extracting a frame the code does: let suffix = buf.split_off(pos + delim_len); buf = suffix; This discards the processed frame by splitting buf at the delimiter end, then replacing buf with the returned suffix. The cleaner idiomatic alternative is buf.drain(..pos + delim_len); which drains (discards) the processed frame prefix in-place, leaving buf as the remaining suffix without the intermediate variable. drain avoids the temporary String allocation and makes the intent (discard prefix, keep suffix) more explicit.
